# Load candidates

results = []

    with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(c, f)

    # Run rank_candidate.py on it
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "scripts/rank_candidate.py", tmp_path],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )

    if proc.returncode == 0:
        # Parse stdout as JSON boolean
        scorer_rank = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
        scorer_status = "scorer_ok"
    else:
        scorer_rank = None
        scorer_status = "scorer_error"

    results.append({
        "id": c["id"],
        "text": c["text"],
        "default_rank": candidates.index(c),
        "scorer_rank": scorer_rank,
        "scorer_status": scorer_status,
        "scorer_stdout": proc.stdout.strip(),
        "scorer_stderr": proc.stderr.strip()
    })

# Write ranking.json
with open("out/ranking.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
